meta.window_basis: one window for every group, 2026-06 to 2026-09: 2026-09 is the last quarter whose shareholding filings are in for every filing group, so mutual funds and filing groups cover the same months
meta.how_to_read: Every group has a value for every segment. 0 means the group held and traded nothing there. null means the group cannot be measured over this window (group_info window_note says why) - never write it as 0. Compare groups only when their from_month and to_month match. matrix rows follow matrix.segments, columns follow matrix.groups.
meta.mf_note: mutual-fund groups are the whole industry for that scheme type (All Mutual Funds)
meta.other_change_note: other_change_cr = value change minus net buying: mostly price, plus corporate actions and (for filing books) dilution - not separated further here

notes: Net buying is holdings-implied: change in split/bonus-adjusted shares x that month's price. It is not reported cash trading, and month-end holdings miss trades inside a month.
New listings (stocks whose price history starts inside the window) are shown apart: a first holding at listing is an allocation or a pre-listing stake becoming visible, not buying in the market.

Insurance, pension, banks, AIFs, other domestic institutions and foreign investors come from QUARTERLY shareholding filings valued each month: their buying shows only in March, June, September and December, and a fall in the share they hold can be new shares issued rather than selling.
So the groups can be compared, the 3, 6 and 12 month windows are the same months for every group, ending at the last quarter whose filings are in; the 1 month window measures mutual funds only.
Sectors and size bands are each stock's label today, applied to every month.
